sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October. The club has posted about avenging a recent cup defeat to Alsager on penalties in this local derby clash. Sandbach then travel to face Allscott Heath on Saturday 10 October in their second fixture of the week.
divisionWide: Saturday's opening round sees several significant matchups across the division. Stafford Town (second place, 20 points) travel to Dawley Town for their first-ever visit to the Theatre of Jockeys. AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall in a clash between two strong performers, while third-placed Bilston Town host Crewe and fifth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a derby fixture. Struggling Widnes Town face Brereton Social, and Cheadle Heath Nomads welcome Telford Town—both sides fighting near the bottom of the table. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, Foley Meir entertain Bilston Town, and Shawbury United visit Barnton. Allscott Heath, posting about making it five wins in a row, travel to Crewe looking to maintain their impressive form. The midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community. By Saturday 10 October, Bilston Town host Crewe, Market Drayton Town face Widnes Town, Telford Town visit New Mills, Stafford Town host Wednesfield Community, and Alsager Town travel to Shawbury United in a battle between lower-table sides.
